ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Use the geometric vertex/ray method. First rewrite the system of inequalities as half-planes: x+y-3≥0, that is y≥3-x; x-y+1≥0, that is y≤x+1; 3x-y-5≤0, that is y≥3x-5. Find the pairwise intersection points of the three boundary lines: y=3-x and y=x+1 intersect, giving x=1,y=2, that is (1,2); y=3-x and y=3x-5 intersect, giving x=2,y=1, that is (2,1); y=x+1 and y=3x-5 intersect, giving x=3,y=4, that is (3,4). Therefore region M is the closed triangle with vertices (1,2), (2,1), and (3,4). The line y=kx passing through a point inside region M is equivalent to there existing a point (x,y) in M satisfying k=y/x. The x-coordinates of the three vertices of this triangle are all positive, and the whole triangle lies on the x>0 side, so when a ray emitted from the origin intersects the triangle, the minimum value and maximum value of the slope k are given by the two tangent rays passing through the triangle, that is, they are attained at the relevant vertices. Calculate the slopes of the three vertices relative to the origin: the slope of (1,2) is 2/1=2; the slope of (2,1) is 1/2; the slope of (3,4) is 4/3. Therefore the minimum slope is 1/2, and the maximum slope is 2. The region contains the boundary, so the endpoints can be taken.

method.method_draft: 几何顶点/射线法：先把不等式组改写成半平面 y >= 3-x, y <= x+1, y >= 3x-5。求三条边界直线两两交点，得到区域 M 是三角形，顶点为 (1,2), (2,1), (3,4)。直线 y=kx 经过 M 内某点等价于从原点发出的斜率为 k 的射线与该三角形相交。因为三角形全部在 x>0 一侧，点的斜率 y/x 的最大、最小值由从原点到三角形的两条切射线给出，也就是在相关顶点处取得。计算三个顶点斜率：2, 1/2, 4/3，所以 k 的范围为 [1/2, 2]。
method.CoT_raw: 按几何顶点/射线法。先把不等式组改写为半平面：x+y-3≥0 即 y≥3-x；x-y+1≥0 即 y≤x+1；3x-y-5≤0 即 y≥3x-5。三条边界直线两两求交点：y=3-x 与 y=x+1 相交，得 x=1,y=2，即 (1,2)；y=3-x 与 y=3x-5 相交，得 x=2,y=1，即 (2,1)；y=x+1 与 y=3x-5 相交，得 x=3,y=4，即 (3,4)。因此区域 M 是以 (1,2)、(2,1)、(3,4) 为顶点的闭三角形。直线 y=kx 经过区域 M 内的点，等价于存在 M 中一点 (x,y) 满足 k=y/x。该三角形三个顶点的 x 坐标均为正，且整个三角形在 x>0 一侧，所以从原点发出的射线与三角形相交时，斜率 k 的最小值和最大值由过三角形的两条切射线给出，即在相关顶点处取得。计算三个顶点相对于原点的斜率：(1,2) 的斜率为 2/1=2；(2,1) 的斜率为 1/2；(3,4) 的斜率为 4/3。故最小斜率为 1/2，最大斜率为 2。区域含边界，所以端点可取。

method.method_draft: 代入消元/投影法：直接令经过区域内点的直线为 y=kx，把 y=kx 代入三个不等式，得到 (1+k)x >= 3, (1-k)x >= -1, (3-k)x <= 5。也可先由原不等式的上下界 y >= 3-x, y <= x+1, y >= 3x-5 推出可行点必须满足 1 <= x <= 3。对固定 x>0，将 y=kx 改写为 k=y/x，则三条约束变成 k >= 3/x - 1, k <= 1 + 1/x, k >= 3 - 5/x，其中 x in [1,3]。于是对每个 x，可行 k 属于 [max(3/x-1, 3-5/x), 1+1/x]。比较两个下界函数，它们在 x=2 处相等；分区间 [1,2] 与 [2,3] 求这些 k 区间的并集，可得总范围为 [1/2, 2]。
